January, 2023

Author: N.R. Borkar
Bench: N.R. Borkar

In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Anticipatory Bail Application No. 163 Of 2023
 1. Umaji Panghaji Shelar
 2. Sopan Panghaji Shelar

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. Bugabai @ Gitabai Sahadu Katke ...Applicants
 Versus
 The State of Maharashtra ...Respondent
 .........
 Mr. Vaibhav Ugle a/w Mr. Roshan Chavan for the Applicant.
 Mr. Amit Palkar, App for the State.

Dated : 20 January 2023 P.C. :-
This is an application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for
anticipatory bail.

2.  The applicants are apprehending their arrest in Crime No. 359 of 2022 registered at Talegaon Dabhade police station for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 465, 467, 468, 471, 472 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The allegations against the present applicants are of preparing the forged relinquishment deed dated 14 December 2000, which is notarized document.

According to him, on the date of execution of relinquishment deed,
he was not Notary.
5. Considering the fact that the applicant Nos. 1 and 2 are beneficiary of the said relinquishment deed, I am not inclined to release them on anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: The Application of applicant No. 1 and applicant No. 2 is rejected.
7. As regards the applicant No. 3, she is not the beneficiary.
On the contrary, she is alleged to have relinquished her share in the property in favor of the applicant Nos. 1 and 2.
I am therefore inclined to release the applicant No. 3 on anticipatory bail.

Hence, the following order is passed:
(i) Application is partly allowed.
(ii) In the event of arrest of applicant No. 3- Bugabai @ Gitabai Sahadu Katke in Crime No. 359 of 2022 registered at Talegaon Dabhade police Digitally signed by MANGALTAI MANGALTAI JAYWANT JAYWANT JADHAV station for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 465, 467, 468, JADHAV Date:
2023.02.02 14:59:02 +0530 471, 472 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code, she shall be released on bail on furnishing PR bond in the sum of Rs. 15,000/- with one surety in the like amount.
( N.R. BORKAR, J. )
